name: Nav item
summary: Link in a side navigation, with icon, label and an optional count. In a collapsed sidebar it shows only the icon.
use: Main navigation of an app or portal.
anatomy: Collapsed: icon, dot for the count, tooltip with the label.
reactProps: Word after the count for screen readers. Default "new".
behaviour: Goes to a page. The active page is highlighted.
Inside a collapsed Sidebar the item switches to compact mode by itself (NavCompactContext).
a11y: Real links in a <nav> with aria-label.
The count gets context for screen readers, for example "10 new".
In compact mode the label stays in the link name. The tooltip is aria-hidden.
do: About 7 items per group at most.
dont: Two active items at the same time.
